create_maze_env: create a MazeEnv with a custom bit map, start position, and goal position for a single-agent grid world
create_horizontal_maze_env: create a HorizontalMazeEnv with a 15x15 grid and a non-optimal path of 80 moves
create_maze3_env: create a Maze3Env with a 15x15 grid maze layout starting at position 4,1 and goal at 13,7
create_corridor_env: create a SmallCorridorEnv or LargeCorridorEnv with randomized goal positions for backtracking navigation tasks
create_labyrinth_env: create a LabyrinthEnv or Labyrinth2Env with a 15x15 grid and a non-optimal path of 118 moves
